# AKM Portfolio — LLM Context

Anjani Kumar Mishra (AKM) is a Finance Analyst, FP&A Enthusiast & Fintech Developer based in Hyderabad, India.
ACCA trainee (13 papers), BCom (Hons) at GITAM University.

## Core Expertise
- **Finance:** Financial Modeling (DCF, 3-Statement), IFRS, Variance Analysis, Ratio Analysis, Risk Management
- **Fintech:** BQL in Excel, Crypto/DeFi, Client-Side BI Dashboards, IndexedDB, Chart.js
- **Tech:** HTML/CSS/JS, TailwindCSS, Chart.js, Plotly.js, PowerBI, Bloomberg Terminal
- **AI:** Prompt Engineering, NotebookLM, AI-Assisted Financial Modeling
